python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data from Table 2: Computed annual interest charge (Public debt) in millions
# FY 1961-1967
data = {
    1961: 3072,
    1962: 3240,
    1963: 3361,
    1964: 3561,
    1965: 3678,
    1966: 3988,
    1967: 4039,
    1968: 4499  # Actual for comparison
}

# Years and values (in billions)
years = np.array([1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967])
values = np.array([data[y]/1000 for y in years])  # Convert to billions

# OLS: Simple linear regression y = a + b*x
# Using year as numeric (or centered for better precision)
x_mean = np.mean(years)
y_mean = np.mean(values)

# Calculate slope b and intercept a
numerator = np.sum((years - x_mean) * (values - y_mean))
denominator = np.sum((years - x_mean)**2)
b = numerator / denominator
a = y_mean - b * x_mean

print(f"OLS Regression: y = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * x")
print(f"where x is the fiscal year")

# Forecast for FY 1968
forecast_1968 = a + b * 1968
print(f"\nForecast for FY 1968: {forecast_1968:.6f} billion dollars")

# Actual value for FY 1968
actual_1968 = data[1968] / 1000
print(f"Actual FY 1968: {actual_1968:.6f} billion dollars")

# Forecast error (actual - forecast)
error = actual_1968 - forecast_1968
print(f"\nForecast Error (actual - forecast): {error:.6f} billion dollars")

# More detail
print(f"\n--- Verification ---")
for year in years:
    fitted = a + b * year
    print(f"FY {year}: {fitted:.6f} (actual: {data[year]/1000:.3f})")

EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
# Final verification

# Data: Computed annual interest charge on public debt (in billions)
# From Table 2 in Treasury Bulletin 1969-01, page 30
years = [1961, 1962, 1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967]
values = [3.072, 3.240, 3.361, 3.561, 3.678, 3.988, 4.039]  # billions

# OLS calculation
n = len(years)
x_mean = sum(years) / n
y_mean = sum(values) / n

numerator = sum((years[i] - x_mean) * (values[i] - y_mean) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - x_mean)**2 for i in range(n))
b = numerator / denominator
a = y_mean - b * x_mean

# Forecast for 1968
forecast_1968 = a + b * 1968
actual_1968 = 4.499

# Error = actual - forecast
error = actual_1968 - forecast_1968

print("=== OLS Linear Trend Analysis ===")
print(f"Years: {years}")
print(f"Values (billions): {values}")
print(f"\nOLS: y = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * year")
print(f"\nForecast for FY 1968: {forecast_1968:.6f} billion")
print(f"Actual for FY 1968: {actual_1968:.3f} billion")
print(f"\nForecast Error (actual - forecast): {error:.6f} billion")
print(f"\n=== ANSWER: {error:.6f} ===")

EOF
